primary_biological_variables.matched_definition: Comparison between diseased and healthy or unaffected controls.
evidence: The term amyloidoma applies to localized deposits of amyloid in the absence of systemic amyloidosis.
The salient clinical features of the 4 cases of musculoskeletal amyloidoma analyzed in this study are summarized in Table I.

To investigate possible biological pathways linked with calcification, proteins identified from case 2 (calcified femur amyloidoma) were compared with proteins from case 3 (normal appearance femur amyloidoma).
An online tool was used to compare the Protein Groups between case 1 and 2.
